title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood shoe shop: an exchange-period notice, a first day working the counter, a store-usage guide, a repair-hours-change notice, an online-reservation guide, a reflection on sizing by foot shape, a first custom-insole consultation, the shop's history from repair shop to custom insoles, a points-and-repair-service guide, a 3D foot-scan trend column, a hybrid membership-rank system guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and craftsmanship, and an annual report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
